label: An endless populated past would admit a Grim Reaper system of locally ruled stations
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred (Grim Reaper style): for every accessible history and every strictly descending sequence of its moments starting at a moment where a contingent concrete individual is present, some Nat-indexed system of stations satisfies the four local rules of the indexed signal Reaper (index admissibility, positive trigger, emission, forwarding). The consequent is a closed proposition about Nat functions that does not mention the sequence, the history or its moments, and the verified IndexedSignalReaper.impossible refutes it; so the bridge is equivalent to 'no such descent exists', a reformulation of founded populated pasts, not an independent patchwork principle. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter, read under the adopted esse criterion (CONCRETE_6); the Lean type does not enforce that reading.
